title: “The small against the many” SCA Hanukkah message by Ness Hadeff

chapters.title: Introduction and Parshiyot
chapters.about: Ness Dev introduces Hanukkah and the connection to Parshat Vayeishev and Parshat Miketz.

summary: Ness Dev discusses the holiday of Hanukkah in relation to Parshat Vayeishev and Parshat Miketz. The class explores the idea of the small and weak defeating the large and strong through the stories of Yosef, Paroh, and the Maccabees.
questions: How do the dreams of Yosef and Paroh relate to the story of Hanukkah?
Why did the Maccabees win against the Greeks?
What does the Torah teach about the small defeating the large?
